name: ProteinLMBench
intro: ProteinLMBench是一个用于评估大型语言模型蛋白质理解能力的选择题基准。论文作者让LLM阅读下载的研究论文生成蛋白质问答，经机器与人工验证后，从超过10万条候选问答中随机抽取944道带答案解释的人工标注题，覆盖蛋白质性质预测、描述与序列理解。
org: Toursun Synbio, Johns Hopkins University, University of Cambridge, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, UNSW Sydney
build_method: LLM阅读蛋白质研究论文产题，机器与作者双重验证，从超过10万条问答池随机抽取944题
task_type: 科学问答, 蛋白质任务
eval_feature: 论文目标格式为六选一且附正确答案解释，题目经机器与人工验证，未设置推荐数据划分
scale: 944道人工标注选择题；从超过10万条蛋白质问答池随机抽取
build_method_en: Use an LLM to draft questions from protein research papers, validate them by machine and paper authors, and randomly sample 944 items from a pool exceeding 100,000 QA pairs
eval_feature_en: The paper targets six-choice items with correct-answer explanations, validates them by machine and humans, and recommends no data split
intro_en: ProteinLMBench is a multiple-choice benchmark for evaluating LLM protein understanding. The paper authors used an LLM to read downloaded research papers and generate protein QA, validated candidates by machine and humans, and randomly sampled 944 manually annotated questions with explanations from a pool exceeding 100,000 pairs, covering protein property prediction, descriptions, and sequence understanding.
scale_en: 944 manually annotated multiple-choice questions, randomly sampled from a pool of more than 100,000 protein QA pairs
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按论文、数据说明与官方Hugging Face文件核对论文阅读产题、机器与作者验证、超过10万问答池随机抽样、944题、答案解释、主题覆盖和Accuracy评测。论文规定六选一；公开JSON中少量记录的选项数偏离六项，图中保留论文定义并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。
